name: the owner's cut of the demo film

music.method: four single 30 s generations, no continuations (the CC-209 long track failed with silent gaps from continuations)

jobs.name: act1-wonder
jobs.prompt: cinematic wonder, gentle piano arpeggios, soft swelling strings, slow rising awe, 100 bpm, instrumental, no vocals, no drums

jobs.name: act2-pulse
jobs.prompt: playful building pulse, marimba and pizzicato strings, soft taiko drum, 100 bpm, curious energy rising, instrumental, no vocals

jobs.name: act3-drive-a
jobs.prompt: epic taiko drums, driving string ostinato, heroic adventure chase, 100 bpm, fast and exciting, instrumental, no vocals

jobs.name: act3-drive-b
jobs.prompt: epic taiko drums, driving string ostinato, heroic adventure chase, 100 bpm, fast and exciting, instrumental, no vocals

mix.recipe: act1 24.6 s x2.2 gain, act2 22.2 s, act3 = act3-drive-a 29.1 s + 9.6 s of itself with a 0.3 s crossfade x1.6 gain; acts joined with 0.6 s crossfades on bar lines at 24.0 and 45.6 s; fade in 0.4 s, fade out from 81.6 s over 2.4 s; limiter 0.89; libvorbis q6
mix.silenceCheck: no silent gaps (ffmpeg silencedetect at -45 dB, 1.5 s) in any of the four generations or the mix

picture.render: cd demo && npm run render:demo -> test-results/demo-film.mp4

takes.flyover: 240 frames, 0 exact duplicate pictures; film window from 1.0 s
takes.dive: 360 frames (films/take-dive2.mp4), 0 duplicates; window from 1.5 s (the first second can still be the plain camera before the film pose takes over)
takes.lache: 216 frames (films/take-lache2.mp4), 0 duplicates; --skip 22 --ramp 1.0,5.6,0.25 with film=follow; probe log (films/probe-lache.log) measured jump 23.23 s, grab 23.92 s, let go 24.76 s, landing 25.55 s; in the take the grab lands at output 4.33 s and the Remotion dim is fully dark at 3.96 s, so the grab is never visible
takes.lacheFirstAttempt: an earlier --from-x 140 take filmed only the end-of-run results card; --skip is the reliable way in (noted in docs/film-craft.md)
takes.coasterDroneGhostRookies: coaster 120, drone 240, ghost 180, rookie-a 270, rookie-b 270 frames; 0 exact duplicate pictures each
takes.marksFiles: films/*.marks.json next to each screen recording
